下面只陈述有证据支持的 PFI 论文结论，并标明缺口（无法归入“共同结论”）。

**PFI 论文的实验条件（仅针叶/阔叶漂白硫酸盐浆）**
- 打浆：PFI 磨，浆浓 10%，盘间隙 0.2 mm，比压 3.33 N/mm（针叶浆）与 1.77 N/mm（阔叶浆），转数 0/4000/8000/12000/16000 r；对应打浆度分别 16→79 °SR（针叶）与 0/26/40/57/70 °SR（阔叶）[1]。

**主要结果**
- 形态与润胀：两种浆的宏观纤丝化指数与纤维长度下降、针叶浆细小纤维含量上升；针叶浆变化显著，阔叶浆这两项相对不显著（作者归因于其打浆压力更低）[5]。打浆度与 WRV 随转数显著上升，源于纤丝化产生的新表面与孔隙[5]。
- 强度：湿纸幅强度上升（针叶浆增幅更明显，纤维长度起关键作用）；零距抗张表明 PFI 打浆未降低纤维本身强度；干纸页抗张强度提高[5]。
- 结晶区：晶型未变；CI-XI 与 CI-XA 分别下降 4.66%/15.47%（针叶）与 2.65%/19.4%（阔叶），两者显著相关（r = 0.919 与 0.925，p < 0.05）；微晶尺寸变化很小（约 3.0–4.8 nm）[9]。
- 氢键网络：O(6)H···O(3′) 含量总体下降 16.54%（针叶）与 5.91%（阔叶）；O(3)H···O(5) 上升 22.78% 与 8.8%；O(2)H···O(6) 总体下降（仅 0→4000 r 阶段上升）[8]。
- 核心结论：纤丝化与纤维性能变化同超分子结构（微晶尺寸、结晶度、各类氢键含量）变化相关；CI-XI 与 O(6)H···O(3′) 含量显著正相关，故打浆中可由 CI-XI 推测该氢键趋势；总体结晶度、微晶尺寸与氢键含量变化不大，故认为 PFI 打浆是“以纤丝化为主、对超分子结构破坏较小”的温和机械处理[7]。

claim_assessments.text:
**二、PFI 论文的实验条件（仅针叶/阔叶漂白硫酸盐浆）**
- 纤维为国产商品漂白硫酸盐浆（针叶/阔叶）；采用 PFI 磨（Hamjern Maskin A/S），按 Tappi T248 wd-97，浆浓 10%，盘间隙 0.2 mm，比压 3.33 N/mm（针叶）与 1.77 N/mm（阔叶）[1]。
- 转数 0/4000/8000/12000/16000 r；对应打浆度（ISO 5267-1，Schopper Riegler）针叶浆为 16、20、40、63、79 °SR，阔叶浆为 0、26、40、57、70 °SR[1]。注意：原文对两组均写作“0、4000、8000、12000、16000 r”，但针叶浆给出的打浆度最低值为 16 °SR 而非 0，原文表述存在不一致，未加解释。

**三、PFI 论文的主要结果（相对量）**
- 形态：两种浆的宏观纤丝化指数与纤维长度均呈下降趋势，针叶浆细小纤维含量上升；针叶浆这两项变化显著，阔叶浆则相对不显著。作者将其归因于阔叶浆所用打浆压力更低，这是作者的解释性推断，并非独立验证的因果结论[5]。
- 润胀与比表面：打浆度与 WRV 随转数显著上升，作者归因于纤丝化产生的新的表面与孔隙（比表面与孔结构数据在补充材料 Table S1，正文未给出数值）[5]。
- 强度：湿纸幅强度上升，针叶浆增幅更明显，作者以纤维长度起关键作用解释；零距抗张指数表明 PFI 打浆未降低纤维强度；干纸页抗张强度提高[5]。上述均为变化方向与相对比较，按证据未给出具体数值。
- 结晶区：纤维素晶型未变；CI-XI 与 CI-XA 分别下降 4.66% 与 15.47%（针叶）、2.65% 与 19.4%（阔叶）；两种指数显著相关，r = 0.919（针叶）与 0.925（阔叶），p < 0.05；微晶尺寸变化很小（原文表列约 2.9–4.8 nm，随晶面与转数小幅波动）[9]。原文同时指出 CI-XI 明显高于 CI-XA，可能源于无定形贡献拟合过度，因此两指数的绝对值不宜直接比较[9]。
- 氢键：O(6)H···O(3′) 含量总体下降 16.54%（针叶）与 5.91%（阔叶）；O(3)H···O(5) 总体上升 22.78% 与 8.8%；O(2)H···O(6) 总体下降（仅 0→4000 r 阶段上升）。原文强调这些氢键既有断裂也有生成，趋势呈阶段性波动[8]。
- 结论：纤丝化与纤维性能变化同超分子结构（微晶尺寸、结晶度、各类氢键含量）变化相关；CI-XI 与 O(6)H···O(3′) 含量显著正相关，作者据此推测打浆中可由 CI-XI 估计该氢键趋势；总体结晶度、微晶尺寸与氢键含量变化不大，故作者认为 PFI 打浆是“以纤丝化为主、对超分子结构破坏较小”的温和处理[7]。此处“相关”为统计相关，“温和、破坏较小”为作者基于变化幅度的判断。

**四、结论**
在缺少非木材纤维文献数据的前提下，唯一有据可陈的是上述 PFI 论文结果；任何“两文共同结论”的表述均无证据支持。若需完成比较，请提供该文献的 PDF、DOI 或库内文档名。

candidate.answer:
按该研究的 PFI 条件（浆浓 10%、磨盘间隙 0.2 mm；针叶木浆和阔叶木浆的比压分别为 3.33 N/mm 和 1.77 N/mm；依据 TAPPI T248 wd-97，打浆度按 ISO 5267-1 测定），**12000 转时：针叶木浆为 63 °SR，阔叶木浆为 57 °SR** [1]。

对应的打浆序列是：

- 针叶木浆：0、4000、8000、12000、16000 转 → **16、20、40、63、79 °SR** [1]
- 阔叶木浆：0、4000、8000、12000、16000 转 → **0、26、40、57、70 °SR** [1]

因此：

- 如果目标浆就是该研究中的**漂白针叶木硫酸盐浆**，那么在本实验条件下打到 12000 转对应约 63 °SR [1]。
- 但不能把“12000 转”当作通用的 63 °SR 方案。相同转数下，**阔叶木浆只有 57 °SR** [1]；若要让阔叶木浆达到 63 °SR，需要超过 12000 转，但文献只给出 12000 转→57 °SR、16000 转→70 °SR 两端点，并未给出达到 63 °SR 所需的转数，因此需在 12000–16000 转之间试打确定，属于未解决的信息缺口 [1]。
- 不同浆种和批次、初始打浆度、PFI 比压、盘间隙、浆浓及磨片状态均可能改变打浆曲线，因此 12000 转只能作为参考起点，生产中应以**实测 °SR**为准。该文献未报告这些打浆度数值的重复性误差或不确定度 [1]。

Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds [原文] On the whole, the amount of the O(6)H· · · O(30) H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers decreased by 16.54% and 5.91% altogether, respectively. The decrease might be due to the cleavage among cellulose molecular chains under the mechanical action of PFI refining, which was closely related to internal and external fibrillation (as seen in Section 3.1). On the other hand, the increase illustrates that there was not only the breakage, but also the formation of O(6)H· · · O(30) H-bonds. Both the fewer inter-molecular H-bonds and the lower CI (as Section 3.2 shows) will further improve the flexibility of cellulosic fibers, due to the higher mobility of molecular chains, the accessibility, and the WRV of fibers (as seen in Section 3.1). [章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds [原文] As to the O(3)H· · · O(5) intra-molecular H-bonds of softwood fiber, the content had a growth of 10.09% from 28.44% to 31.31% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r, and then had a slight decrease of 1.44% from 4000 r to 8000 r, followed by an increase of 13.16% until the end of refining. Overall, the trend was similar to that of hardwood fibers, which first increased and then had a decrease, followed by a growth. During the whole refining, the amount of $\mathrm { O } ( 3 ) \mathrm { H } \cdots \mathrm { O } ( 5 )$ H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers showed an upward tendency and increased by 22.78% and 8.8%, respectively. The increase might be because the stable O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds might have not only less breakage under the action of water as destructor to the crystallites [30], but also creation in the amorphous region upon drying. Because hydrogen bond–covalent bond synergies play an important role in the cellulose stifness axial modulus, more O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds will enhance the cellulose stifness [33,34]. [章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds [原文] In the case of the O(2)H· · · O(6) intra-molecular H-bonds for softwood fiber, the trend of content can be described as two phases. It had an increase of 3.5% from 31.4% to 32.5% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r and it then decreased by 21.57% from 4000 r to 12000 r, along with a growth of 15.26% in the last refining stage. For the content of the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds of hardwood fiber, it increased firstly and then had a decrease that was also followed by an increase. For both fibers, the content of O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds decreased, except for the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r. It might be due to the fact that the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds, which are much more accessible to water, are less stable than O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds.

sources.text:
[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 2. Methods > 2.1. PFI Refining
[原文]
Commercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp fibers were obtained from Zhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China). Two pulp were treated with a PFI refiner (Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency of 10%, the gap between the opposite refining plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were 3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, respectively. The drainability was characterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp fibers were separately refined in a PFI refiner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an increasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79<sup>◦</sup> SR, were obtained for softwood fibers and 0, 26, 40, 57, and 70<sup>◦</sup> SR were obtained for hardwood fibers.

claims.text: 按该研究的 PFI 条件（浆浓 10%、磨盘间隙 0.2 mm；针叶木浆和阔叶木浆的比压分别为 3.33 N/mm 和 1.77 N/mm；依据 TAPPI T248 wd-97，打浆度按 ISO 5267-1 测定），**12000 转时：针叶木浆为 63 °SR，阔叶木浆为 57 °SR** [1]。

因此：

- 如果目标浆就是该研究中的**漂白针叶木硫酸盐浆**，那么在本实验条件下打到 12000 转对应约 63 °SR [1]。
- 但不能把“12000 转”当作通用的 63 °SR 方案。相同转数下，**阔叶木浆只有 57 °SR** [1]；若要让阔叶木浆达到 63 °SR，需要超过 12000 转，但文献只给出 12000 转→57 °SR、16000 转→70 °SR 两端点，并未给出达到 63 °SR 所需的转数，因此需在 12000–16000 转之间试打确定，属于未解决的信息缺口 [1]。
- 不同浆种和批次、初始打浆度、PFI 比压、盘间隙、浆浓及磨片状态均可能改变打浆曲线，因此 12000 转只能作为参考起点，生产中应以**实测 °SR**为准。该文献未报告这些打浆度数值的重复性误差或不确定度 [1]。

无法给出所问的数值——“本文已训练好的纸张抗张预测模型”在当前可获得的证据中并不存在，因此验证集 R²、RMSE 以及最佳模型名称均无法确定。

核查情况：
- 两次检索（已达每次问答的检索上限）均只命中同一篇文献：Li (2020) 关于 PFI 磨浆对纤维素聚集结构与性能影响的研究 [1][2][7]。
- 该文为实验表征类研究，内容涉及纤维形态与打浆度/WRV [1]、XRD 结晶度与微晶尺寸 [5]、FT-IR 氢键解析 [3]，以及按 TAPPI T494 实测干纸页抗张强度、按 GBT 12914-2008 测湿纸幅强度、按 ISO 15361 测零距抗张强度 [2]。其中没有机器学习或统计预测模型的训练过程、验证集划分，也没有模型间的比较与“最佳模型”的选择。
- 该文中出现的 R²（如软木纤维各磨浆转数下为 0.9995–0.9996）是 FT-IR 羟基谱带非线性拟合的拟合优度 [3]，并非预测模型验证集上的 R²，二者不可混用。
- 该文结论部分讨论的是 PFI 磨浆过程中超分子结构（微晶尺寸、结晶度、各类氢键含量）的变化，以及 CI-XI 与 O(6)H···O(3′) 氢键含量之间的正相关（该相关仅在所研究的软木与硬木浆、0–16,000 转 PFI 磨浆条件下成立，属相关性而非因果，原文亦仅以“might be generally speculated”表述推测）[11][12]。这些都不是预测模型结果。

[原文]
The results indicated that the fibrillation and properties of fibers are related to the variation of the supramolecular structure during PFI refining. It is noticeable that there was a significantly positive correlation between the CI-XI and content of O(6)H· · · O(3)’ H-bonds during PFI refining for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers. Thus, the trend of the content of O(6)H· · · O(3)’ H-bonds might be generally speculated based on CI-XI while refining. Besides, the crystallite size, crystallinity, and content of various H-bonds did not change much in general. It is assumed that PFI refining is an excellent mechanical treatment of fibrillation with relatively little destruction on the supramolecular structure.

Efect of PFI Refining on Crystalline Index and Crystallite Size [原文] The trends of CI (CI-XI and CI-XA) for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers were all similar, decreasing first and then increasing, along with a decline, as shown in Figure 4. The fluctuation of the CI was probably because of the mechanical action of PFI refining on the diferent regions of cellulose. In the first refining stage, the decrease of the CI showed that mechanical treatment may mainly act in the crystalline region. Subsequently, the growth of the CI could be interpreted as greater force acting on the amorphous region in which cocrystallization might occur upon drying under the mechanical and thermal action of PFI refining. The subsequent decrease might be the continuous destruction of crystalline region. [章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.2. Efect of PFI Refining on Crystalline Index and Crystallite Size [原文] Recently, researches indicated that plant cell walls commonly contained microfibrils with 18 cellulose chains [26]. Frequently adopted arrangements of the 18 cellulose chains are 234432, 34443, and 333333 [27]. Therein, 234432 arrangement was found to be more probable based on calculation [28]. sources.text:
[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 4. Conclusions
[原文]
The results indicated that the fibrillation and properties of fibers are related to the variation of the supramolecular structure during PFI refining. It is noticeable that there was a significantly positive correlation between the CI-XI and content of O(6)H· · · O(3)’ H-bonds during PFI refining for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers. Thus, the trend of the content of O(6)H· · · O(3)’ H-bonds might be generally speculated based on CI-XI while refining. Besides, the crystallite size, crystallinity, and content of various H-bonds did not change much in general. It is assumed that PFI refining is an excellent mechanical treatment of fibrillation with relatively little destruction on the supramolecular structure.

- 该文为实验表征类研究，内容涉及纤维形态与打浆度/WRV [1]、XRD 结晶度与微晶尺寸 [5]、FT-IR 氢键解析 [3]，以及按 TAPPI T494 实测干纸页抗张强度、按 GBT 12914-2008 测湿纸幅强度、按 ISO 15361 测零距抗张强度 [2]。其中没有机器学习或统计预测模型的训练过程、验证集划分，也没有模型间的比较与“最佳模型”的选择。

**结论：该文献没有提供“针叶木 8000 转”这一组干纸抗张指数的逐次平行实验原始数据，因此无法列出。**

依据与说明：Li 等（2020）的 PFI 打浆研究中，

- 针叶木浆在转数为 0、4000、8000、12 000、16 000 的 PFI 下打浆；其中 8000 转时针叶木的 SR 值为 40°SR[3]。
- 干纸抗张强度只注明按 TAPPI T494 测试，并未交代试样数量、平行次数或单次测量值[6]。
- 抗张指数、零-span 抗张指数和湿纸幅强度都只以“随打浆转数变化”的曲线形式出现在 Figure 3 中，针叶木为 (a) 图、阔叶木为 (b) 图[11][20]；正文只说明抗张强度随打浆转数升高而增大，并将其归因于打浆过程产生的细纤维化和细组分增加[20]。这是作者给出的解释，并未证明机制。
- 文中没有抗张指数的数值表；仅有 Table 1（结晶度、晶粒尺寸）和 Table 2（氢键相对含量），它们与力学性能无关[1][2]。
- 补充材料仅含 XRD 拟合、FT-IR 拟合与 BET 数据[5]，不包含力学平行数据。

因此：8000 转针叶木的干纸抗张指数只能从 Figure 3(a) 读取近似值；但文中未说明该图是否带误差棒、误差棒对应几次重复，且本次我未查看该图，故不给读数。若要逐次平行原始值，需向作者索取原始记录。

如果另有给出平行实验表格的文献（如中文制浆造纸期刊论文），可提供题名或关键词，我再协助定位。

The decrease might be due to the cleavage among cellulose molecular chains under the mechanical action of PFI refining, which was closely related to internal and external fibrillation (as seen in Section 3.1). On the other hand, the increase illustrates that there was not only the breakage, but also the formation of O(6)H· · · O(30) H-bonds. Both the fewer inter-molecular H-bonds and the lower CI (as Section 3.2 shows) will further improve the flexibility of cellulosic fibers, due to the higher mobility of molecular chains, the accessibility, and the WRV of fibers (as seen in Section 3.1). It might be due to the fact that the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds, which are much more accessible to water, are less stable than O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds.

[原文]
Commercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp fibers were obtained from Zhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China). Two pulp were treated with a PFI refiner (Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency of 10%, the gap between the opposite refining plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were 3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, respectively. The drainability was characterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp fibers were separately refined in a PFI refiner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an increasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79<sup>◦</sup> SR, were obtained for softwood fibers and 0, 26, 40, 57, and 70<sup>◦</sup> SR were obtained for hardwood fibers.

As to the free OH(2) and OH(6) of softwood fiber, the relative content showed a slight increase trend in general. The enhancement of the free OH(2) and OH(6) was understandable, because there was the breakage of H-bonds among cellulosic molecules, which resulted in more extensive delamination and higher specific surface area (as shown in Figure S4 and Table S1 in Online Resource). This made cellulose more accessible to water and chemicals. However, for the free OH(2) and OH(6) of hardwood fiber, the number of the free OH(2) and OH(6) decreased by 21.65% from 14.32% to 11.22%, with revolutions increasing from 0 r to 4000 r, followed by an increase of 45.37% in the stage of refining from 4000 r to 12,000 r, along with an decrease of 17.11%. It could be explained by the instability of free OH groups, which makes it easy to form new H-bonds, such as O(2)H· · · O(6) or O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>)H-bonds. Thus although there is the formation of free OH(2) and OH(6) during fibrillation, the content of the free OH(2) and OH(6) might disease; meanwhile, the content of the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) or the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds might increase upon drying.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 4. Conclusions
[原文]
The results indicated that the fibrillation and properties of fibers are related to the variation of the supramolecular structure during PFI refining. It is noticeable that there was a significantly positive correlation between the CI-XI and content of O(6)H· · · O(3)’ H-bonds during PFI refining for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers. Thus, the trend of the content of O(6)H· · · O(3)’ H-bonds might be generally speculated based on CI-XI while refining. Besides, the crystallite size, crystallinity, and content of various H-bonds did not change much in general. It is assumed that PFI refining is an excellent mechanical treatment of fibrillation with relatively little destruction on the supramolecular structure.

The trends of CI (CI-XI and CI-XA) for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers were all similar, decreasing first and then increasing, along with a decline, as shown in Figure 4. The fluctuation of the CI was probably because of the mechanical action of PFI refining on the diferent regions of cellulose. In the first refining stage, the decrease of the CI showed that mechanical treatment may mainly act in the crystalline region. Subsequently, the growth of the CI could be interpreted as greater force acting on the amorphous region in which cocrystallization might occur upon drying under the mechanical and thermal action of PFI refining. The subsequent decrease might be the continuous destruction of crystalline region.

[原文]
 On the whole, the amount of the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers decreased by 16.54% and 5.91% altogether, respectively. The decrease might be due to the cleavage among cellulose molecular chains under the mechanical action of PFI refining, which was closely related to internal and external fibrillation (as seen in Section 3.1). On the other hand, the increase illustrates that there was not only the breakage, but also the formation of O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds. Both the fewer inter-molecular H-bonds and the lower CI (as Section 3.2 shows) will further improve the flexibility of cellulosic fibers, due to the higher mobility of molecular chains, the accessibility, and the WRV of fibers (as seen in Section 3.1).

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds
[原文]
As to the O(3)H· · · O(5) intra-molecular H-bonds of softwood fiber, the content had a growth of 10.09% from 28.44% to 31.31% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r, and then had a slight decrease of 1.44% from 4000 r to 8000 r, followed by an increase of 13.16% until the end of refining. Overall, the trend was similar to that of hardwood fibers, which first increased and then had a decrease, followed by a growth. During the whole refining, the amount of $\mathrm { O } ( 3 ) \mathrm { H } \cdots \mathrm { O } ( 5 )$ H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers showed an upward tendency and increased by 22.78% and 8.8%, respectively. The increase might be because the stable O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds might have not only less breakage under the action of water as destructor to the crystallites [30], but also creation in the amorphous region upon drying. Because hydrogen bond–covalent bond synergies play an important role in the cellulose stifness axial modulus, more O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds will enhance the cellulose stifness [33,34].

[原文]
In the case of the O(2)H· · · O(6) intra-molecular H-bonds for softwood fiber, the trend of content can be described as two phases. It had an increase of 3.5% from 31.4% to 32.5% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r and it then decreased by 21.57% from 4000 r to 12000 r, along with a growth of 15.26% in the last refining stage. For the content of the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds of hardwood fiber, it increased firstly and then had a decrease that was also followed by an increase. For both fibers, the content of O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds decreased, except for the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r. It might be due to the fact that the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds, which are much more accessible to water, are less stable than O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 2. Methods > 2.1. PFI Refining
[原文]
Commercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp fibers were obtained from Zhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China). Two pulp were treated with a PFI refiner (Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency of 10%, the gap between the opposite refining plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were 3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, respectively. The drainability was characterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp fibers were separately refined in a PFI refiner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an increasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79<sup>◦</sup> SR, were obtained for softwood fibers and 0, 26, 40, 57, and 70<sup>◦</sup> SR were obtained for hardwood fibers.

Commercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp fibers were obtained from Zhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China). Two pulp were treated with a PFI refiner (Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency of 10%, the gap between the opposite refining plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were 3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, respectively. The drainability was characterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp fibers were separately refined in a PFI refiner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an increasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79<sup>◦</sup> SR, were obtained for softwood fibers and 0, 26, 40, 57, and 70<sup>◦</sup> SR were obtained for hardwood fibers.

basis.text: In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers.

## 结论先说

在检索到的这项 PFI 打浆研究中（漂白针叶木硫酸盐浆和漂白阔叶木硫酸盐浆，浆浓 10%、磨盘间隙 0.2 mm、PFI 打浆 0–16 000 转；针叶浆打浆度 16→79°SR，阔叶浆 0→70°SR）[2]，作者把纸页抗张强度的提升**主要归因于打浆过程中的分丝帚化和细小纤维增加**，而不是纤维长度；纤维长度在打浆中反而下降。WRV 上升是表征内部细纤维化和润胀的中间环节；作者只做了定性讨论，没有回归或贡献率分解，因此**无法确定细小纤维与 WRV 中哪一个贡献更大**。

## 一步步的机理链

1. **形态改变**：PFI 打浆中，针叶浆的宏观细纤维化指数与纤维长度**显著下降**，细小纤维含量**上升**；外部细纤维化随打浆增强，与比表面积增大一致 [2]。阔叶浆的这两项参数变化不显著，作者推测与施加的打浆比压较低有关 [1]。
2. **比表面积与孔隙增加，打浆度和 WRV 显著上升**：细纤维化产生新表面和更多孔隙 [3]。用 WRV 表征的吸润增加使纤维横向更柔顺，从而有助于改善纤维网络的纤维间结合强度 [4]；纤维形态分析与 WRV 结果均表明，细纤维化及微纤丝间的分离随打浆增大 [5]。
3. **强度上升**：抗张指数随打浆转数增加，作者称主要由分丝帚化和细小纤维引起 [6]。
4. **不是纤维本身变强**：零距抗张指数显示，PFI 打浆未降低纤维强度（与 Kouko 等的报道一致）[7]；因此干纸强度增益来自纤维间的结合。
5. **化学层面**：O(6)H···O(3′) 分子间氢键相对含量整体分别下降约 16.5%（针叶）和 5.9%（阔叶），三种氢键的键能与键长基本不变 [8]。作者指出，分子间氢键减少与结晶度降低可提高纤维素纤维的柔顺性，从而提高链段活动性、可及度和 WRV [8]，但这是作者的解释，未做因果验证。
6. **例外：湿纸幅强度更依赖纤维长度**：针叶浆湿纸幅强度的增幅大于阔叶浆，作者归因于纤维长度对湿纸幅强度的重要作用 [9]。

## 关于“哪个贡献最大”

- **可以支持（定性）**：抗张强度提升的直接原因在于形态/结合层面，即细纤维化与细小纤维，以及表征内部细纤维化和润胀的 WRV [6][4]；**纤维长度不是驱动因素，反而在打浆中下降** [1]。
- **不能确定**：文中没有对纤维长度、细小纤维含量与 WRV 做相关分析、回归或方差分解，也未给出各自贡献比例，故“细小纤维与 WRV 谁贡献更大”**缺乏定量证据**，无法从本文判断。

Commercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp fibers were obtained from Zhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China). Two pulp were treated with a PFI refiner (Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency of 10%, the gap between the opposite refining plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were 3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, respectively. The drainability was characterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp fibers were separately refined in a PFI refiner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an increasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79<sup>◦</sup> SR, were obtained for softwood fibers and 0, 26, 40, 57, and 70<sup>◦</sup> SR were obtained for hardwood fibers.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 2. Methods > 2.1. PFI Refining
[原文]
Commercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp fibers were obtained from Zhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China). Two pulp were treated with a PFI refiner (Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency of 10%, the gap between the opposite refining plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were 3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, respectively. The drainability was characterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp fibers were separately refined in a PFI refiner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an increasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79<sup>◦</sup> SR, were obtained for softwood fibers and 0, 26, 40, 57, and 70<sup>◦</sup> SR were obtained for hardwood fibers.

claims.text:
## 结论先说

在检索到的这项 PFI 打浆研究中（漂白针叶木硫酸盐浆和漂白阔叶木硫酸盐浆，浆浓 10%、磨盘间隙 0.2 mm、PFI 打浆 0–16 000 转；针叶浆打浆度 16→79°SR，阔叶浆 0→70°SR）[2]，作者把纸页抗张强度的提升**主要归因于打浆过程中的分丝帚化和细小纤维增加**，而不是纤维长度；纤维长度在打浆中反而下降。WRV 上升是表征内部细纤维化和润胀的中间环节；作者只做了定性讨论，没有回归或贡献率分解，因此**无法确定细小纤维与 WRV 中哪一个贡献更大**。

## 一步步的机理链

1. **形态改变**：PFI 打浆中，针叶浆的宏观细纤维化指数与纤维长度**显著下降**，细小纤维含量**上升**；外部细纤维化随打浆增强，与比表面积增大一致 [2]。阔叶浆的这两项参数变化不显著，作者推测与施加的打浆比压较低有关 [1]。
2. **比表面积与孔隙增加，打浆度和 WRV 显著上升**：细纤维化产生新表面和更多孔隙 [3]。用 WRV 表征的吸润增加使纤维横向更柔顺，从而有助于改善纤维网络的纤维间结合强度 [4]；纤维形态分析与 WRV 结果均表明，细纤维化及微纤丝间的分离随打浆增大 [5]。
3. **强度上升**：抗张指数随打浆转数增加，作者称主要由分丝帚化和细小纤维引起 [6]。
4. **不是纤维本身变强**：零距抗张指数显示，PFI 打浆未降低纤维强度（与 Kouko 等的报道一致）[7]；因此干纸强度增益来自纤维间的结合。
5. **化学层面**：O(6)H···O(3′) 分子间氢键相对含量整体分别下降约 16.5%（针叶）和 5.9%（阔叶），三种氢键的键能与键长基本不变 [8]。作者指出，分子间氢键减少与结晶度降低可提高纤维素纤维的柔顺性，从而提高链段活动性、可及度和 WRV [8]，但这是作者的解释，未做因果验证。
6. **例外：湿纸幅强度更依赖纤维长度**：针叶浆湿纸幅强度的增幅大于阔叶浆，作者归因于纤维长度对湿纸幅强度的重要作用 [9]。

## 关于“哪个贡献最大”

- **可以支持（定性）**：抗张强度提升的直接原因在于形态/结合层面，即细纤维化与细小纤维，以及表征内部细纤维化和润胀的 WRV [6][4]；**纤维长度不是驱动因素，反而在打浆中下降** [1]。
- **不能确定**：文中没有对纤维长度、细小纤维含量与 WRV 做相关分析、回归或方差分解，也未给出各自贡献比例，故“细小纤维与 WRV 谁贡献更大”**缺乏定量证据**，无法从本文判断。

basis.text: In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers.

## 结论先说

在检索到的这份 PFI 打浆研究（漂白针叶/阔叶硫酸盐浆，0–16 000转，浆浓10%、磨盘间隙0.2 mm，针叶SR 16→79°、阔叶0→70°）[2] 里，**强度提升的主因是“纤维分丝帚化＋细小纤维增加”带来的结合面积/结合强度，而不是纤维长度**；WRV 上升（润胀/内部细纤维化）是这条因果链的关键中间环节，但作者并未做回归或贡献率分解，因此**没有给出“哪个因素贡献最大”的定量排序**。

## 一步步的机理链

1. **机械作用先改变形态**：PFI 打浆中针叶浆的宏观细纤维化指数（macro-fibrillation index）与纤维长度**显著下降**，细小纤维含量**上升**；外部细纤维化随打浆增强，与比表面积增大一致。阔叶浆因施加的比压更低，这两项参数变化不显著 [17][1]。
2. **比表面积与孔隙增加 → 打浆度、WRV 显著上升**：细纤维化产生新表面和更多孔隙 [4]；吸润（WRV 表征）增加使纤维在横向更柔顺，从而**改善纤维间结合强度** [8]；形态分析与 WRV 共同表明细纤维化及微纤丝间距随打浆增大 [9]。
3. **强度上升主要归因于分丝帚化与细小纤维**：抗张指数随打浆转数上升，“主要由于打浆过程中的分丝帚化和细小纤维” [11]。
4. **不是靠纤维本身变强**：零距抗张指数显示 PFI 打浆**未降低纤维强度**，与 Kouko 等一致 [13]；所以干纸强度增益来自结合而非单纤维强度。
5. **化学层面只发生小幅重组**：O(6)H···O(3′) 分子间氢键整体分别下降约 16.5%（针叶）与 5.9%（阔叶），氢键键能与键长基本不变 [3]；分子链活动性提高、可及度与 WRV 上升进一步增加纤维柔顺性。
6. **例外：湿纸幅强度更依赖纤维长度**——针叶浆湿纸幅强度增幅大于阔叶浆，作者归因于纤维长度对湿纸幅强度的关键作用 [12]。

## 关于“哪个贡献最大”

- **可支持的判断（定性）**：形态/结合层面（细纤维化＋细小纤维，及表征内部细纤维化与润胀的 WRV）是抗张强度提升的直接原因；**纤维长度不是驱动因素，反而在打浆中下降** [1][11]。
- **不能支持的判断**：文中没有对三者做相关分析、回归或方差分解，也没有给出各自贡献百分比；因此“细小纤维 vs WRV 谁更大”**缺乏直接定量证据**。若要排序，需要能提供该类统计（如以抗张指数对长度、细小纤维含量、WRV 做多元回归/通径分析）的文献，本次两次检索均未检到。

## 结论先说

在检索到的这项 PFI 打浆研究中（漂白针叶木硫酸盐浆和漂白阔叶木硫酸盐浆，浆浓 10%、磨盘间隙 0.2 mm、PFI 打浆 0–16 000 转；针叶浆打浆度 16→79°SR，阔叶浆 0→70°SR）[2]，作者把纸页抗张强度的提升**主要归因于打浆过程中的分丝帚化和细小纤维增加**，而不是纤维长度；纤维长度在打浆中反而下降。WRV 上升是表征内部细纤维化和润胀的中间环节；作者只做了定性讨论，没有回归或贡献率分解，因此**无法确定细小纤维与 WRV 中哪一个贡献更大**。

## 一步步的机理链

1. **形态改变**：PFI 打浆中，针叶浆的宏观细纤维化指数与纤维长度**显著下降**，细小纤维含量**上升**；外部细纤维化随打浆增强，与比表面积增大一致 [2]。阔叶浆的这两项参数变化不显著，作者推测与施加的打浆比压较低有关 [1]。
2. **比表面积与孔隙增加，打浆度和 WRV 显著上升**：细纤维化产生新表面和更多孔隙 [3]。用 WRV 表征的吸润增加使纤维横向更柔顺，从而有助于改善纤维网络的纤维间结合强度 [4]；纤维形态分析与 WRV 结果均表明，细纤维化及微纤丝间的分离随打浆增大 [5]。
3. **强度上升**：抗张指数随打浆转数增加，作者称主要由分丝帚化和细小纤维引起 [6]。
4. **不是纤维本身变强**：零距抗张指数显示，PFI 打浆未降低纤维强度（与 Kouko 等的报道一致）[7]；因此干纸强度增益来自纤维间的结合。
5. **化学层面**：O(6)H···O(3′) 分子间氢键相对含量整体分别下降约 16.5%（针叶）和 5.9%（阔叶），三种氢键的键能与键长基本不变 [8]。作者指出，分子间氢键减少与结晶度降低可提高纤维素纤维的柔顺性，从而提高链段活动性、可及度和 WRV [8]，但这是作者的解释，未做因果验证。
6. **例外：湿纸幅强度更依赖纤维长度**：针叶浆湿纸幅强度的增幅大于阔叶浆，作者归因于纤维长度对湿纸幅强度的重要作用 [9]。

candidate.answer:
## 先核对一个前提（证据与问题设定不完全一致）

本次检索到的文献中，PFI 打浆**并未把纤维素从 I 型变成 II 型**。Li 等对软木浆和硬木浆进行 PFI 打浆（0–16000 转）后，XRD 结果显示两种纤维的**晶型（polymorph）全程未变**，作者据此认为 PFI 属于"相对温和的机械处理"[3]；该文的 XRD 解析也只涉及纤维素 Iα/Iβ 晶面，如 (1-10)、(110)、(200) [5]。同一文献还指出，关于 PFI 打浆对结晶度的影响，前人结论互相矛盾：有的报道下降，有的报道先升后降，并无一致趋势[1]。

因此，在讨论"转变后结晶度为什么还降"之前，建议先确认 XRD 上究竟是**峰位**（纤维素 II 的特征峰约在 2θ ≈ 12°、20°、21.8°）真的出现，还是仅峰形/峰强度变化被解读为晶型转变。本次证据不支持"PFI 打浆诱导 I→II 转变"这一前提。

## 若确实发生了 I→II，结晶度仍下降的可能解释（基于证据的机制，外推部分须验证）

1. **转变过程本身可能伴随晶区破坏，两者并不互斥。** 该文献对 PFI 结晶度波动的解释是：初期 CI 下降说明机械作用"主要作用于结晶区"，后段下降则归因于"结晶区的持续破坏"[13]。作者还指出，水分子优先从亲水的 (1-10)/(110) 面渗入**准晶区（paracrystalline）**，使这些晶面更易受机械作用，造成链断裂与干燥时的共结晶并存[6][18]。据此可设想：残余晶体虽已重排为 II 型，但相当部分链区被转化为无定形，有序尺寸变小，表观结晶度随之下降。不过，这属于从纤维素 I 体系的外推，作者并未研究纤维素 II 体系。

   实测数据（16000 转 vs 未打浆）：软木 CI‑XI 73.23%→69.82%、CI‑XA 40.46%→34.20%；硬木 75.55%→73.55%、47.16%→38.01%[12]；线性降幅报道为软木 −4.66%/−15.47%、硬木 −2.65%/−19.4%[8]。注意，这些数值对应的是**晶型未变的纤维素 I 样品**，作者同时报告 CI 趋势为"先降后升再降"的波动，而非单调下降[13]。

2. **晶粒尺寸极小，晶型重排可能带来应变与缺陷（外推）。** 这些浆的晶粒垂直方向尺寸仅约 3–5 nm[12]，且不同晶面响应不一致：垂直 (1-10) 面的尺寸波动最大（水化 + 机械作用），而垂直 (200) 面的尺寸反而上升（相邻微纤丝 (200) 面在干燥时对齐、链合并）[6][18]。如此小的晶粒，若堆垛方式改变，峰宽化/应变增加会使面积法结晶度和 Scherrer 晶粒尺寸同时"下降"，这反映的是有序度/缺陷变化，而不只是晶型种类。该推论在纤维素 I 数据上成立，向纤维素 II 的外推未经检验。

3. **测量层面的可比性问题（重要）。** 该文的 CI‑XI 用纤维素 Iβ 的 (200) 峰（2θ 22–23°）与 18–19° 的无定形谷计算[5]，这是为纤维素 I 标定的 Segal 类指标；两种指标本身差异巨大（如未打浆软木 CI‑XI 73.23% vs CI‑XA 40.46%，作者归因于无定形贡献过拟合）[2][9][12]。晶型换成 II 后主峰位置改变，同一公式给出的数值不宜与 I 型样品直接相减比较，因此"结晶度下降"中可能有一部分是指标伪影，而非真实结晶度变化。相关结论需用分峰法（Pearson VII 等）[5]或全谱拟合重新验证。

4. **关于纤维素 II 本征结晶度（证据缺口）**：纤维素 II 由反平行链堆垛、经溶胀/去晶化路径生成，其本征结晶度与晶粒尺寸可能低于纤维素 I。但这一点在本次检索到的文献中**没有证据支撑**（库内仅 1 篇 PFI 相关文献，且其样品晶型未变），因此不能据此作定量断言。

## 建议的最小验证集
- XRD 报告**原始峰位与分峰参数**（不只报一个 CI 数），确认是否有 12°/20° 的 II 型峰；
- 同时给出 CI‑XI、CI‑XA 及 Scherrer 尺寸，并注明所用公式的晶型适用性[5]；
- 用 FT-IR（如 1430/897 cm⁻¹ 比值）或 CP/MAS ¹³C NMR 交叉验证晶型与有序度。本文用 FT‑IR 氢键解卷积与 CI 做相关分析，Pearson r ≈ 0.89–0.91（p<0.05），说明结晶度变化与分子间 O(6)H···O(3′) 氢键含量同向变化[3][4]；这是相关性，不代表因果，可作为独立判据的辅助。

**证据缺口**：关于"纤维素 II 本征结晶度低于纤维素 I"以及"PFI 打浆可诱导 I→II"这两点，本次两轮检索均未获得文献证据；上述第 1–3 条机制有[5][6][12][13][18]支持（但均在晶型未变的纤维素 I 样品上得出），第 4 条为未验证假设。

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
Mechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired physical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic fibers. Therein, Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining is the most common laboratory refiner in order to improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main efects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [1]. These efects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
 It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during refining [7,8].

There are some diferent conclusions regarding to the efects of PFI refining on crystallinity of cellulose, not like that of ball milling, which efectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment progresses. Although some researchers considered that the crystallinity decreased during PFI refining for corn stover [9] or softwood pulp [10], some researchers reported that the crystallinity increased first and then decreased with the degree of refining for hardwood bleached kraft pulp fibers [11] or for unbleached eucalyptus fibers [12]. Moreover, Zhao et al. [7] reported that the crystallinity initially fluctuated upward and then downward, followed by a repeating fluctuation with PFI refining for tobacco stem mechanical pulp. None of the previous studies identified a clear trend, but the results were that the crystallinity varied during PFI refinement. Based on the large proportion of H-bonds in crystalline region of cellulose, it can be assumed that the H-bonding network might change during PFI refining.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
Fourier transformation infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), which is sensitive to molecular structure, can be as an indirect measurement for studying H-bonding network. FT-IR deconvolution of hydroxyl groups band was adopted in order to study the changes of the energy of H-bonds and the H-bonding distance during delignification [13] or the deconstruction of cellulose [14]. Moreover, it was used to study the diferences of the content of H-bonds not only between dislocation region and normal region [15], but also among plant species [16,17]. Regarding the changes of H-bonding network during PFI refining, Yuan et al. [18] reported that the content of H-bonds and crystallinity index (CI) of eucalyptus fibers changed with the increment of beating time. Subsequently, Zhao et al. [8] found that the H-bonding energy for O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) inter-molecular H-bonds decreased by 12.9% and evolutions of the content of certain H-bonds difered at various refining stages.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
There is still a lack of literature on the efects of PFI refinement on the H-bonding network. Particularly, the relationship between the content of H-bonds and crystallinity is still worthy of further study, which will deepen the understanding of the molecular aggregation and distribution of H-bonds, providing a molecular-scale explanation for the variations in accessibility, swelling, flexibility, and fibrillation of cellulosic fibers during PFI refinement. Therefore, this work explored the efects of PFI refinement on the CI, crystallite size, energy of H-bonds, H-bonding distance, and content of H-bonds for softwood pulp fibers and hardwood pulp fibers. Attempts were made in order to establish the correlations between the CI and content of various H-bonds.

Abstract: Supramolecular structure is the critical factor that afects the properties of cellulosic fibers. This article studied the action of Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining on the molecular aggregation and hydrogen bonding network, and tried to explore the relationship between the crystal packing and hydrogen-bonding network in cellulosic fibers. The results showed that the polymorph, H-bonding distance, and H-bonding energy of various H-bonds remained almost unchanged, while the crystalline index, crystallite size, and content of various H-bonds changed with refining. Therein, the content of the inter-molecular O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds was significantly correlated with the crystalline index that was obtained in intensities of the XRD peaks. The Pearson correlation coeficient between them was 0.888 (p < 0.05) for softwood fibers and 0.889 (p < 0.05) for hardwood fibers, respectively. It can be concluded that the variations of accessibility, swelling, and fibrillation were closely related to the supramolecular structure and the intermolecular H-bonds play an important role in the crystal packing of cellulose.

The crystallinity of pretreated fibers was determined by a Shimadzu XRD 7000S (Shimadzu, Kyoto, Japan), while using Cu-Ka radiation. The samples were scanned at 40 kV and 30 mA in a 2θ range of $4 { - } 4 0 ^ { \circ }$ at 1<sup>◦</sup>/min. It is well known that two polymorphs, cellulose Iα and Iβ, are present in native cellulose; for clarity, all of the reflections indexed here are on the Iβ lattice. Before analysis, the experimental data is nine point smoothed with Savitzky–Golay algorithm. The two types of CI values were obtained from peak intensity method (CI − XI) and peak fitting (CI-XA), respectively. The CI − XI was calculated as in Equation (2) [19].

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
Mechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired physical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic fibers. Therein, Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining is the most common laboratory refiner in order to improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main efects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [1]. These efects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
 It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during refining [7,8].

There are some diferent conclusions regarding to the efects of PFI refining on crystallinity of cellulose, not like that of ball milling, which efectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment progresses. Although some researchers considered that the crystallinity decreased during PFI refining for corn stover [9] or softwood pulp [10], some researchers reported that the crystallinity increased first and then decreased with the degree of refining for hardwood bleached kraft pulp fibers [11] or for unbleached eucalyptus fibers [12]. Moreover, Zhao et al. [7] reported that the crystallinity initially fluctuated upward and then downward, followed by a repeating fluctuation with PFI refining for tobacco stem mechanical pulp. None of the previous studies identified a clear trend, but the results were that the crystallinity varied during PFI refinement. Based on the large proportion of H-bonds in crystalline region of cellulose, it can be assumed that the H-bonding network might change during PFI refining.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
Fourier transformation infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), which is sensitive to molecular structure, can be as an indirect measurement for studying H-bonding network. FT-IR deconvolution of hydroxyl groups band was adopted in order to study the changes of the energy of H-bonds and the H-bonding distance during delignification [13] or the deconstruction of cellulose [14]. Moreover, it was used to study the diferences of the content of H-bonds not only between dislocation region and normal region [15], but also among plant species [16,17]. Regarding the changes of H-bonding network during PFI refining, Yuan et al. [18] reported that the content of H-bonds and crystallinity index (CI) of eucalyptus fibers changed with the increment of beating time. Subsequently, Zhao et al. [8] found that the H-bonding energy for O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) inter-molecular H-bonds decreased by 12.9% and evolutions of the content of certain H-bonds difered at various refining stages.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
There is still a lack of literature on the efects of PFI refinement on the H-bonding network. Particularly, the relationship between the content of H-bonds and crystallinity is still worthy of further study, which will deepen the understanding of the molecular aggregation and distribution of H-bonds, providing a molecular-scale explanation for the variations in accessibility, swelling, flexibility, and fibrillation of cellulosic fibers during PFI refinement. Therefore, this work explored the efects of PFI refinement on the CI, crystallite size, energy of H-bonds, H-bonding distance, and content of H-bonds for softwood pulp fibers and hardwood pulp fibers. Attempts were made in order to establish the correlations between the CI and content of various H-bonds.

[原文]
Abstract: Supramolecular structure is the critical factor that afects the properties of cellulosic fibers. This article studied the action of Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining on the molecular aggregation and hydrogen bonding network, and tried to explore the relationship between the crystal packing and hydrogen-bonding network in cellulosic fibers. The results showed that the polymorph, H-bonding distance, and H-bonding energy of various H-bonds remained almost unchanged, while the crystalline index, crystallite size, and content of various H-bonds changed with refining. Therein, the content of the inter-molecular O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds was significantly correlated with the crystalline index that was obtained in intensities of the XRD peaks. The Pearson correlation coeficient between them was 0.888 (p < 0.05) for softwood fibers and 0.889 (p < 0.05) for hardwood fibers, respectively. It can be concluded that the variations of accessibility, swelling, and fibrillation were closely related to the supramolecular structure and the intermolecular H-bonds play an important role in the crystal packing of cellulose.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 2. Methods > 2.4. XRD Analysis
[原文]
The crystallinity of pretreated fibers was determined by a Shimadzu XRD 7000S (Shimadzu, Kyoto, Japan), while using Cu-Ka radiation. The samples were scanned at 40 kV and 30 mA in a 2θ range of $4 { - } 4 0 ^ { \circ }$ at 1<sup>◦</sup>/min. It is well known that two polymorphs, cellulose Iα and Iβ, are present in native cellulose; for clarity, all of the reflections indexed here are on the Iβ lattice. Before analysis, the experimental data is nine point smoothed with Savitzky–Golay algorithm. The two types of CI values were obtained from peak intensity method (CI − XI) and peak fitting (CI-XA), respectively. The CI − XI was calculated as in Equation (2) [19].

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 2. Methods > 2.4. XRD Analysis
[原文]
$$
C I - X I = \frac {\left(I _ {2 0 0} - I _ {a m}\right)}{I _ {2 0 0}} \times 1 0 0 \%\tag{2}
$$

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 2. Methods > 2.4. XRD Analysis
[原文]
where I200 is the maximum difraction intensity value of the (200) lattice plane between the scattering angles of $2 \Theta = 2 2 ^ { \circ }$ and $2 3 ^ { \circ }$ , and $I _ { a m }$ is the minimum difraction intensity of amorphous fraction between $2 \Theta = 1 8 ^ { \circ }$ and $1 9 ^ { \circ }$

All of the XRD difractograms were smoothed with the Savitzky–Golay algorithm and baseline-corrected with linear fit function. Subsequently, the baseline-corrected difractograms were deconvoluted with the Pearson VII function. The value of the CI-XA equals the area percentage occupied by crystalline peaks over the total area of the difraction pattern [20]. In addition, the crystallite size was calculated by the widely used Scherrer Equation (3) [21]:

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 2. Methods > 2.4. XRD Analysis
[原文]
$$
L = \frac {k \times \lambda}{(\beta \times \cos \theta)}\tag{3}
$$

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 2. Methods > 2.4. XRD Analysis
[原文]
where L is the size that is perpendicular to the lattice plane, k is a constant that depends on the crystal shape (0.89), λ is the wavelength of the incident beam in the difraction experiment (0.154 nm), $\beta$ is the full width at half maximum of the difraction peak, and θ is the Bragg’s angle. In general, the values of the calculated crystallite sizes might be lower than that of the real crystallite sizes, because the peak broadening from the instrumental factors was not considered [22].

claims.text:
## 先核对一个前提（证据与问题设定不完全一致）

本次检索到的文献中，PFI 打浆**并未把纤维素从 I 型变成 II 型**。Li 等对软木浆和硬木浆进行 PFI 打浆（0–16000 转）后，XRD 结果显示两种纤维的**晶型（polymorph）全程未变**，作者据此认为 PFI 属于"相对温和的机械处理"[3]；该文的 XRD 解析也只涉及纤维素 Iα/Iβ 晶面，如 (1-10)、(110)、(200) [5]。同一文献还指出，关于 PFI 打浆对结晶度的影响，前人结论互相矛盾：有的报道下降，有的报道先升后降，并无一致趋势[1]。
因此，在讨论"转变后结晶度为什么还降"之前，建议先确认 XRD 上究竟是**峰位**（纤维素 II 的特征峰约在 2θ ≈ 12°、20°、21.8°）真的出现，还是仅峰形/峰强度变化被解读为晶型转变。本次证据不支持"PFI 打浆诱导 I→II 转变"这一前提。

## 若确实发生了 I→II，结晶度仍下降的可能解释（基于证据的机制，外推部分须验证）

1. **转变过程本身可能伴随晶区破坏，两者并不互斥。** 该文献对 PFI 结晶度波动的解释是：初期 CI 下降说明机械作用"主要作用于结晶区"，后段下降则归因于"结晶区的持续破坏"[13]。作者还指出，水分子优先从亲水的 (1-10)/(110) 面渗入**准晶区（paracrystalline）**，使这些晶面更易受机械作用，造成链断裂与干燥时的共结晶并存[6][18]。据此可设想：残余晶体虽已重排为 II 型，但相当部分链区被转化为无定形，有序尺寸变小，表观结晶度随之下降。不过，这属于从纤维素 I 体系的外推，作者并未研究纤维素 II 体系。

实测数据（16000 转 vs 未打浆）：软木 CI‑XI 73.23%→69.82%、CI‑XA 40.46%→34.20%；硬木 75.55%→73.55%、47.16%→38.01%[12]；线性降幅报道为软木 −4.66%/−15.47%、硬木 −2.65%/−19.4%[8]。注意，这些数值对应的是**晶型未变的纤维素 I 样品**，作者同时报告 CI 趋势为"先降后升再降"的波动，而非单调下降[13]。

2. **晶粒尺寸极小，晶型重排可能带来应变与缺陷（外推）。** 这些浆的晶粒垂直方向尺寸仅约 3–5 nm[12]，且不同晶面响应不一致：垂直 (1-10) 面的尺寸波动最大（水化 + 机械作用），而垂直 (200) 面的尺寸反而上升（相邻微纤丝 (200) 面在干燥时对齐、链合并）[6][18]。如此小的晶粒，若堆垛方式改变，峰宽化/应变增加会使面积法结晶度和 Scherrer 晶粒尺寸同时"下降"，这反映的是有序度/缺陷变化，而不只是晶型种类。该推论在纤维素 I 数据上成立，向纤维素 II 的外推未经检验。

3. **测量层面的可比性问题（重要）。** 该文的 CI‑XI 用纤维素 Iβ 的 (200) 峰（2θ 22–23°）与 18–19° 的无定形谷计算[5]，这是为纤维素 I 标定的 Segal 类指标；两种指标本身差异巨大（如未打浆软木 CI‑XI 73.23% vs CI‑XA 40.46%，作者归因于无定形贡献过拟合）[2][9][12]。晶型换成 II 后主峰位置改变，同一公式给出的数值不宜与 I 型样品直接相减比较，因此"结晶度下降"中可能有一部分是指标伪影，而非真实结晶度变化。相关结论需用分峰法（Pearson VII 等）[5]或全谱拟合重新验证。
4. **关于纤维素 II 本征结晶度（证据缺口）**：纤维素 II 由反平行链堆垛、经溶胀/去晶化路径生成，其本征结晶度与晶粒尺寸可能低于纤维素 I。但这一点在本次检索到的文献中**没有证据支撑**（库内仅 1 篇 PFI 相关文献，且其样品晶型未变），因此不能据此作定量断言。

- XRD 报告**原始峰位与分峰参数**（不只报一个 CI 数），确认是否有 12°/20° 的 II 型峰；
- 同时给出 CI‑XI、CI‑XA 及 Scherrer 尺寸，并注明所用公式的晶型适用性[5]；

**证据缺口**：关于"纤维素 II 本征结晶度低于纤维素 I"以及"PFI 打浆可诱导 I→II"这两点，本次两轮检索均未获得文献证据；上述第 1–3 条机制有[5][6][12][13][18]支持（但均在晶型未变的纤维素 I 样品上得出），第 4 条为未验证假设。

**干纸抗张性能的结论**

- PFI 打浆过程中，干纸的抗张强度（以抗张指数表示）随打浆转数增加而提高 [14]；作者把这一提高主要归因于打浆过程中纤丝化程度提高和细小纤维含量增加 [14]。
- 作者还解释了纤维网络结合增强的原因：WRV 升高表明纤维润胀增加，纤维横向因此更柔顺，从而有利于纤维间结合强度提高 [11]。这些是作者的机理解释，不是通过分离变量证明的因果。
- 零距抗张指数结果表明，PFI 打浆没有降低纤维强度；作者据此认为，纸页抗张强度的提高并不是以纤维本身强度下降为代价 [16]。
- 作者的总体结论是：PFI 打浆提高了纤丝化程度（尤其是内部纤丝化）和纤维润胀，并提高了纸页抗张强度，同时纤维抗张强度没有下降 [17]。
- 方法条件：干纸抗张强度按 TAPPI T494 测定，零距抗张强度按 ISO 15361 测定 [1]。

**关于耐破指数和撕裂指数**

这篇论文没有报告耐破指数和撕裂指数，因此无法给出同一批样品的这两项精确数据。文中涉及的力学指标只有抗张指数、零距抗张指数和湿纸幅强度（图 3）[18][14]；测试标准只提到 TAPPI T494、GB/T 12914-2008 和 ISO 15361，未涉及耐破度或撕裂度测试 [1]。若需这两项数据，只能查该研究的补充材料或其他来源；就目前检索到的正文、图和表格而言，未发现相应数值，故不能提供或推测。

The zero-span tensile strength was tested with the Z-Span 2400 apparatus (Pulmac International Co. Ltd., Montpelier, VT, USA), according to the standard ISO 15361.

claims.text:
**干纸抗张性能的结论**

- PFI 打浆过程中，干纸的抗张强度（以抗张指数表示）随打浆转数增加而提高 [14]；作者把这一提高主要归因于打浆过程中纤丝化程度提高和细小纤维含量增加 [14]。
- 作者还解释了纤维网络结合增强的原因：WRV 升高表明纤维润胀增加，纤维横向因此更柔顺，从而有利于纤维间结合强度提高 [11]。这些是作者的机理解释，不是通过分离变量证明的因果。
- 零距抗张指数结果表明，PFI 打浆没有降低纤维强度；作者据此认为，纸页抗张强度的提高并不是以纤维本身强度下降为代价 [16]。
- 作者的总体结论是：PFI 打浆提高了纤丝化程度（尤其是内部纤丝化）和纤维润胀，并提高了纸页抗张强度，同时纤维抗张强度没有下降 [17]。
- 方法条件：干纸抗张强度按 TAPPI T494 测定，零距抗张强度按 ISO 15361 测定 [1]。

**关于耐破指数和撕裂指数**

这篇论文没有报告耐破指数和撕裂指数，因此无法给出同一批样品的这两项精确数据。文中涉及的力学指标只有抗张指数、零距抗张指数和湿纸幅强度（图 3）[18][14]；测试标准只提到 TAPPI T494、GB/T 12914-2008 和 ISO 15361，未涉及耐破度或撕裂度测试 [1]。若需这两项数据，只能查该研究的补充材料或其他来源；就目前检索到的正文、图和表格而言，未发现相应数值，故不能提供或推测。

basis.text: In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers.

**干纸抗张性能的结论**

- 该论文（Li 等，2020，PFI 打浆对纤维素聚集结构与氢键的影响）发现：随着 PFI 打浆转数增加，干纸的抗张强度（以抗张指数表示）提高，主要归因于打浆过程中纤丝化程度提高和细小纤维含量增加；同时，纸页的纤维间结合得到增强，因为纤维润胀（WRV 升高）使纤维在横向更柔顺，从而有利于纤维网络结合 [14][11]。
- 零距抗张指数结果表明，PFI 打浆并未降低纤维本身的强度，即干纸强度的提高不是靠牺牲单根纤维强度换来的 [16]。
- 总体结论是：PFI 打浆提高了纤丝化（尤其是内部纤丝化）程度、纤维润胀和纸页抗张强度，且不伴随纤维抗张强度的下降 [17]。
- 方法上，干纸抗张强度按 TAPPI T494 测定，零距抗张强度按 ISO 15361 测定 [1]。

**关于耐破指数和撕裂指数**

这篇论文**没有报告耐破指数（burst index）和撕裂指数（tear index）**，因此无法给出“同一批样品”的这两项精确数据，也不应推测。文中涉及的力学指标只有抗张指数、零距抗张指数和湿纸幅强度（分别对应图 3），测试标准也只提到 TAPPI T494、GB/T 12914-2008 和 ISO 15361，未涉及耐破度或撕裂度测试 [1][14]。若确需这两项数据，需要查阅该研究的补充材料（Online Resource）或其他批次/文献；但就目前检索到的正文与表格而言，没有相应数值。

**无法给出8000转时针叶木浆的具体BET比表面积数值。**

- Li 等（2020）关于PFI打浆对针叶木/阔叶木浆聚集结构影响的研究中，BET比表面积的具体数值没有出现在正文，只放在补充材料里：正文仅说明外部分丝化随打浆增加、与比表面积增加一致（见 Online Resource 的 Table S1），并注明 Table S1 的内容为“针叶木浆纤维经打浆后的累积孔体积、平均孔径和比表面积”，Figure S4 为各打浆转数下的 BET N₂ 吸附/脱附等温线（针叶木与阔叶木）[1][5]。该补充材料数据不在本次可用语料中，因此**8000转时针叶木浆的具体BET比表面积（m²/g数值）无法确定，不作推测**。
- 可确认的实验条件：商业漂白针叶木硫酸盐浆，PFI磨，浆浓10%，针叶木比压3.33 N/mm，打浆转数0、4000、8000、12,000、16,000 r[3]。文中给出的打浆度序列为针叶木16、20、40、63、79 °SR，对应上述0–16,000 r[3]；8000 r 与哪一打浆度对应，原文表述不够明确，若按序列顺序推定为约63 °SR，属推断而非原文结论[3]。
- 同条件、同批样品在8000 r的其他指标（非BET比表面积）：针叶木游离OH(2)与OH(6)相对含量由0 r的11.93%升至8000 r的14.84%[4]；结晶度CI-XI为72.54%、CI-XA为39.65%[8]。这些数值不能替代BET比表面积。

**未确定信息**：8000转时针叶木浆BET比表面积的确切数值、单位与误差范围，仅见于该文补充材料Table S1（或Figure S4），需查阅原文Supplementary Materials方能获得。

[原文]
 On the whole, the amount of the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers decreased by 16.54% and 5.91% altogether, respectively. The decrease might be due to the cleavage among cellulose molecular chains under the mechanical action of PFI refining, which was closely related to internal and external fibrillation (as seen in Section 3.1). On the other hand, the increase illustrates that there was not only the breakage, but also the formation of O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds. Both the fewer inter-molecular H-bonds and the lower CI (as Section 3.2 shows) will further improve the flexibility of cellulosic fibers, due to the higher mobility of molecular chains, the accessibility, and the WRV of fibers (as seen in Section 3.1).

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds
[原文]
As to the O(3)H· · · O(5) intra-molecular H-bonds of softwood fiber, the content had a growth of 10.09% from 28.44% to 31.31% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r, and then had a slight decrease of 1.44% from 4000 r to 8000 r, followed by an increase of 13.16% until the end of refining. Overall, the trend was similar to that of hardwood fibers, which first increased and then had a decrease, followed by a growth. During the whole refining, the amount of $\mathrm { O } ( 3 ) \mathrm { H } \cdots \mathrm { O } ( 5 )$ H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers showed an upward tendency and increased by 22.78% and 8.8%, respectively. The increase might be because the stable O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds might have not only less breakage under the action of water as destructor to the crystallites [30], but also creation in the amorphous region upon drying. Because hydrogen bond–covalent bond synergies play an important role in the cellulose stifness axial modulus, more O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds will enhance the cellulose stifness [33,34].

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds
[原文]
In the case of the O(2)H· · · O(6) intra-molecular H-bonds for softwood fiber, the trend of content can be described as two phases. It had an increase of 3.5% from 31.4% to 32.5% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r and it then decreased by 21.57% from 4000 r to 12000 r, along with a growth of 15.26% in the last refining stage. For the content of the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds of hardwood fiber, it increased firstly and then had a decrease that was also followed by an increase. For both fibers, the content of O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds decreased, except for the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r. It might be due to the fact that the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds, which are much more accessible to water, are less stable than O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds
[原文]
As to the free OH(2) and OH(6) of softwood fiber, the relative content showed a slight increase trend in general. The enhancement of the free OH(2) and OH(6) was understandable, because there was the breakage of H-bonds among cellulosic molecules, which resulted in more extensive delamination and higher specific surface area (as shown in Figure S4 and Table S1 in Online Resource). This made cellulose more accessible to water and chemicals. However, for the free OH(2) and OH(6) of hardwood fiber, the number of the free OH(2) and OH(6) decreased by 21.65% from 14.32% to 11.22%, with revolutions increasing from 0 r to 4000 r, followed by an increase of 45.37% in the stage of refining from 4000 r to 12,000 r, along with an decrease of 17.11%. It could be explained by the instability of free OH groups, which makes it easy to form new H-bonds, such as O(2)H· · · O(6) or O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>)H-bonds. As to the O(3)H· · · O(5) intra-molecular H-bonds of softwood fiber, the content had a growth of 10.09% from 28.44% to 31.31% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r, and then had a slight decrease of 1.44% from 4000 r to 8000 r, followed by an increase of 13.16% until the end of refining. Overall, the trend was similar to that of hardwood fibers, which first increased and then had a decrease, followed by a growth. During the whole refining, the amount of $\mathrm { O } ( 3 ) \mathrm { H } \cdots \mathrm { O } ( 5 )$ H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers showed an upward tendency and increased by 22.78% and 8.8%, respectively. The increase might be because the stable O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds might have not only less breakage under the action of water as destructor to the crystallites [30], but also creation in the amorphous region upon drying. Because hydrogen bond–covalent bond synergies play an important role in the cellulose stifness axial modulus, more O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds will enhance the cellulose stifness [33,34].

In the case of the O(2)H· · · O(6) intra-molecular H-bonds for softwood fiber, the trend of content can be described as two phases. It had an increase of 3.5% from 31.4% to 32.5% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r and it then decreased by 21.57% from 4000 r to 12000 r, along with a growth of 15.26% in the last refining stage. For the content of the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds of hardwood fiber, it increased firstly and then had a decrease that was also followed by an increase. It might be due to the fact that the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds, which are much more accessible to water, are less stable than O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 2. Methods > 2.1. PFI Refining
[原文]
Commercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp fibers were obtained from Zhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China). Two pulp were treated with a PFI refiner (Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency of 10%, the gap between the opposite refining plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were 3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, respectively. The drainability was characterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp fibers were separately refined in a PFI refiner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an increasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79<sup>◦</sup> SR, were obtained for softwood fibers and 0, 26, 40, 57, and 70<sup>◦</sup> SR were obtained for hardwood fibers.

The trends of CI (CI-XI and CI-XA) for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers were all similar, decreasing first and then increasing, along with a decline, as shown in Figure 4. The fluctuation of the CI was probably because of the mechanical action of PFI refining on the diferent regions of cellulose. In the first refining stage, the decrease of the CI showed that mechanical treatment may mainly act in the crystalline region. Subsequently, the growth of the CI could be interpreted as greater force acting on the amorphous region in which cocrystallization might occur upon drying under the mechanical and thermal action of PFI refining. The subsequent decrease might be the continuous destruction of crystalline region.

- Li 等（2020）关于PFI打浆对针叶木/阔叶木浆聚集结构影响的研究中，BET比表面积的具体数值没有出现在正文，只放在补充材料里：正文仅说明外部分丝化随打浆增加、与比表面积增加一致（见 Online Resource 的 Table S1），并注明 Table S1 的内容为“针叶木浆纤维经打浆后的累积孔体积、平均孔径和比表面积”，Figure S4 为各打浆转数下的 BET N₂ 吸附/脱附等温线（针叶木与阔叶木）[1][5]。该补充材料数据不在本次可用语料中，因此**8000转时针叶木浆的具体BET比表面积（m²/g数值）无法确定，不作推测**。
- 可确认的实验条件：商业漂白针叶木硫酸盐浆，PFI磨，浆浓10%，针叶木比压3.33 N/mm，打浆转数0、4000、8000、12,000、16,000 r[3]。文中给出的打浆度序列为针叶木16、20、40、63、79 °SR，对应上述0–16,000 r[3]；8000 r 与哪一打浆度对应，原文表述不够明确，若按序列顺序推定为约63 °SR，属推断而非原文结论[3]。
- 同条件、同批样品在8000 r的其他指标（非BET比表面积）：针叶木游离OH(2)与OH(6)相对含量由0 r的11.93%升至8000 r的14.84%[4]；结晶度CI-XI为72.54%、CI-XA为39.65%[8]。这些数值不能替代BET比表面积。
**未确定信息**：8000转时针叶木浆BET比表面积的确切数值、单位与误差范围，仅见于该文补充材料Table S1（或Figure S4），需查阅原文Supplementary Materials方能获得。

- 在本次可检索到的 Li 等（2020）关于 PFI 打浆对针叶木/阔叶木浆聚集结构影响的研究中，BET 比表面积的具体数值并未出现在正文，而是放在补充材料里：正文多处只说明"外部分丝化随打浆增加，与比表面积的增加一致（见 Online Resource 的 Table S1）"，并注明 Table S1 的内容为"针叶木浆纤维经打浆后的累积孔体积、平均孔径和比表面积"，Figure S4 为各打浆转数下的 BET N₂ 吸附/脱附等温线（针叶木与阔叶木）[1][5]。该补充材料/附录数据不在本次语料中，因此 **8000 转时针叶木浆的具体 BET 比表面积（m²/g 数值）无法给出，我不会猜测**。
- 可确认的实验条件：商业漂白针叶木硫酸盐浆，PFI 磨，浆浓 10%，比压 3.33 N/mm（针叶木），打浆转数 0、4000、8000、12,000、16,000 r[3]。按该文所列打浆度序列（16、20、40、63、79 °SR 依次对应 0–16,000 r），8000 r 大致对应约 63 °SR[3]（该对应关系按顺序推定，文中表述略有含混）。
- 同条件下 8000 r 的其他指标可作参照：针叶木自由 OH(2)、OH(6) 相对含量从 0 r 的 11.93% 升至 8000 r 的 14.84%[4]；结晶度 CI-XI 72.54%、CI-XA 39.65%（8000 r）[8]。

**缺口说明**：本问题所需的 8000 r BET 数值仅存在于该文补充材料 Table S1（或 Figure S4 曲线），需查阅原文 Supplementary Materials 才能给出确切数值及其单位、误差范围。

claim_assessments.text:
**无法给出8000转时针叶木浆的具体BET比表面积数值。**

- Li 等（2020）关于PFI打浆对针叶木/阔叶木浆聚集结构影响的研究中，BET比表面积的具体数值没有出现在正文，只放在补充材料里：正文仅说明外部分丝化随打浆增加、与比表面积增加一致（见 Online Resource 的 Table S1），并注明 Table S1 的内容为“针叶木浆纤维经打浆后的累积孔体积、平均孔径和比表面积”，Figure S4 为各打浆转数下的 BET N₂ 吸附/脱附等温线（针叶木与阔叶木）[1][5]。该补充材料数据不在本次可用语料中，因此**8000转时针叶木浆的具体BET比表面积（m²/g数值）无法确定，不作推测**。
- 可确认的实验条件：商业漂白针叶木硫酸盐浆，PFI磨，浆浓10%，针叶木比压3.33 N/mm，打浆转数0、4000、8000、12,000、16,000 r[3]。文中给出的打浆度序列为针叶木16、20、40、63、79 °SR，对应上述0–16,000 r[3]；8000 r 与哪一打浆度对应，原文表述不够明确，若按序列顺序推定为约63 °SR，属推断而非原文结论[3]。
- 同条件、同批样品在8000 r的其他指标（非BET比表面积）：针叶木游离OH(2)与OH(6)相对含量由0 r的11.93%升至8000 r的14.84%[4]；结晶度CI-XI为72.54%、CI-XA为39.65%[8]。这些数值不能替代BET比表面积。
**未确定信息**：8000转时针叶木浆BET比表面积的确切数值、单位与误差范围，仅见于该文补充材料Table S1（或Figure S4），需查阅原文Supplementary Materials方能获得。

## 结论：不一样

在相同的 PFI 打浆转数（从 0 增加到 16 000 r）下，针叶木纤维长度明显下降，阔叶木则几乎没有变化；根据原文，阔叶木纤维的长度变化和宏观细纤维化指数相对于针叶木而言“无显著变化” [1][8]。

**具体数据（据 Figure 1 估算）** [8]
- 针叶木：长度加权平均纤维长度由约 2000 µm 降至约 1620 µm（约 −19%），同时细组分含量上升、宏观细纤维化指数显著升高 [1][8]。
- 阔叶木：由约 900 µm 降至约 870 µm（约 −3%，在图示误差范围内），变化不显著 [1][8]。

## 差别的原因

1. **打浆强度不同（原文给出的解释）**：两种浆均使用 PFI，转数相同，磨齿间隙均为 0.2 mm，但每齿长作用力分别为针叶木 3.33 N/mm、阔叶木 1.77 N/mm，因此阔叶木受到的机械作用更弱。作者据此推测，阔叶木长度变化不显著“可能是因为对阔叶木施加了更低的磨浆压力” [1][3]。这属于作者的解释或推测，并非已证实的因果结论。

2. **响应方式不同**：阔叶木在打浆过程中主要表现为外部细纤维化与润胀：宏观细纤维化指数、打浆度和保水值上升 [1]，而纤维长度没有显著变化 [1][8]。

3. 原文未报告针叶木长度下降的机理（如切断、分丝）；本资料中没有对此的直接证据。

## 需要注意的不确定性

- 该对比并非等打浆强度实验：树种与施加作用力大小相互混杂，因此不能据此断定“针叶木本质上比阔叶木更易缩短”。
- 除“磨浆压力更低”这一作者推测外，所给文献没有提供壁厚/粗度等纤维形态学机理证据，该部分无法确定。
- 两种浆的打浆度序列也不同（针叶木 16、20、40、63、79 °SR；阔叶木 0、26、40、57、70 °SR）[3]，因此不宜按打浆度对齐比较。

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 4. Conclusions
[原文]
The results indicated that the fibrillation and properties of fibers are related to the variation of the supramolecular structure during PFI refining. It is noticeable that there was a significantly positive correlation between the CI-XI and content of O(6)H· · · O(3)’ H-bonds during PFI refining for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers. Thus, the trend of the content of O(6)H· · · O(3)’ H-bonds might be generally speculated based on CI-XI while refining. Besides, the crystallite size, crystallinity, and content of various H-bonds did not change much in general. It is assumed that PFI refining is an excellent mechanical treatment of fibrillation with relatively little destruction on the supramolecular structure.

 On the whole, the amount of the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers decreased by 16.54% and 5.91% altogether, respectively. The decrease might be due to the cleavage among cellulose molecular chains under the mechanical action of PFI refining, which was closely related to internal and external fibrillation (as seen in Section 3.1). Overall, the trend was similar to that of hardwood fibers, which first increased and then had a decrease, followed by a growth. During the whole refining, the amount of $\mathrm { O } ( 3 ) \mathrm { H } \cdots \mathrm { O } ( 5 )$ H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers showed an upward tendency and increased by 22.78% and 8.8%, respectively. The increase might be because the stable O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds might have not only less breakage under the action of water as destructor to the crystallites [30], but also creation in the amorphous region upon drying. Because hydrogen bond–covalent bond synergies play an important role in the cellulose stifness axial modulus, more O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds will enhance the cellulose stifness [33,34].

The enhancement of the free OH(2) and OH(6) was understandable, because there was the breakage of H-bonds among cellulosic molecules, which resulted in more extensive delamination and higher specific surface area (as shown in Figure S4 and Table S1 in Online Resource). This made cellulose more accessible to water and chemicals. However, for the free OH(2) and OH(6) of hardwood fiber, the number of the free OH(2) and OH(6) decreased by 21.65% from 14.32% to 11.22%, with revolutions increasing from 0 r to 4000 r, followed by an increase of 45.37% in the stage of refining from 4000 r to 12,000 r, along with an decrease of 17.11%. Abstract: Supramolecular structure is the critical factor that afects the properties of cellulosic fibers. This article studied the action of Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining on the molecular aggregation and hydrogen bonding network, and tried to explore the relationship between the crystal packing and hydrogen-bonding network in cellulosic fibers. The results showed that the polymorph, H-bonding distance, and H-bonding energy of various H-bonds remained almost unchanged, while the crystalline index, crystallite size, and content of various H-bonds changed with refining. Therein, the content of the inter-molecular O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds was significantly correlated with the crystalline index that was obtained in intensities of the XRD peaks. The Pearson correlation coeficient between them was 0.888 (p < 0.05) for softwood fibers and 0.889 (p < 0.05) for hardwood fibers, respectively. It can be concluded that the variations of accessibility, swelling, and fibrillation were closely related to the supramolecular structure and the intermolecular H-bonds play an important role in the crystal packing of cellulose.

claims.text:
## 结论：不一样

在相同的 PFI 打浆转数（从 0 增加到 16 000 r）下，针叶木纤维长度明显下降，阔叶木则几乎没有变化；根据原文，阔叶木纤维的长度变化和宏观细纤维化指数相对于针叶木而言“无显著变化” [1][8]。

**具体数据（据 Figure 1 估算）** [8]
- 针叶木：长度加权平均纤维长度由约 2000 µm 降至约 1620 µm（约 −19%），同时细组分含量上升、宏观细纤维化指数显著升高 [1][8]。
- 阔叶木：由约 900 µm 降至约 870 µm（约 −3%，在图示误差范围内），变化不显著 [1][8]。

## 差别的原因

1. **打浆强度不同（原文给出的解释）**：两种浆均使用 PFI，转数相同，磨齿间隙均为 0.2 mm，但每齿长作用力分别为针叶木 3.33 N/mm、阔叶木 1.77 N/mm，因此阔叶木受到的机械作用更弱。作者据此推测，阔叶木长度变化不显著“可能是因为对阔叶木施加了更低的磨浆压力” [1][3]。这属于作者的解释或推测，并非已证实的因果结论。
2. **响应方式不同**：阔叶木在打浆过程中主要表现为外部细纤维化与润胀：宏观细纤维化指数、打浆度和保水值上升 [1]，而纤维长度没有显著变化 [1][8]。
3. 原文未报告针叶木长度下降的机理（如切断、分丝）；本资料中没有对此的直接证据。

## 需要注意的不确定性

- 该对比并非等打浆强度实验：树种与施加作用力大小相互混杂，因此不能据此断定“针叶木本质上比阔叶木更易缩短”。
- 除“磨浆压力更低”这一作者推测外，所给文献没有提供壁厚/粗度等纤维形态学机理证据，该部分无法确定。
- 两种浆的打浆度序列也不同（针叶木 16、20、40、63、79 °SR；阔叶木 0、26、40、57、70 °SR）[3]，因此不宜按打浆度对齐比较。

It might be because of the lower refining pressure that was applied in hardwood fibers. The macro-fibrillation index characterizes external macro-fibrillation. The results of fiber morphology analysis showed that external fibrillation increased with the refining process. 2. **作用方式不同**：阔叶木在打浆中主要表现为外部细纤维化与润胀（宏观细纤维化指数、打浆度、保水值上升），而不是纤维被切断，因此长度基本不变 [1][8]；针叶木纤维更长、更易在磨齿间受弯折剪切而断裂，长度下降并伴随细组分增加 [1][8]。

3. **纤维本体强度未受损**：零距抗张指数显示打浆未降低纤维自身强度 [9]，说明针叶木长度下降更符合“纤维被切断/分丝”而非“纤维被削弱后碎解”。

该对比并非等打浆强度实验：树种（纤维长度、粗度、壁厚等形态差异）与施加作用力大小相互混杂，因此不能仅凭此数据断定“针叶木天生比阔叶木更易缩短”。检索到的文献中，除“磨浆压力更低”外，没有给出壁厚/粗度等形态学机理的直接证据，这一部分仍属未解决的空白。

我检索了两次（已达到本题允许的检索上限），但两次检索都只返回了 PFI 论文（Li 2020，doc_0fcf2a50cfa02d21）；**因此无法从本次可用文献库中检索到《Non-Wood Fibers: Relationships of Fiber Properties with Pulp Properties》，也拿不到它的实验数据**（比如各类非木材原料的纤维长度、宽厚比、细胞壁厚度等指标，以及这些指标与纸浆抗张、耐破、撕裂指数之间的表格、相关性系数或样本量）。因此**无法比较这两篇论文的全部实验数据，也无法给出共同结论**；如果强行给出，就只能是猜测。

下面只陈述有证据支持的 PFI 论文内容；这些内容单独不构成“共同结论”。

**实验条件（仅针叶材与阔叶材漂白硫酸盐浆）**
- PFI 磨打浆：浆浓 10%，盘间隙 0.2 mm，比压 3.33 N/mm（针叶浆）与 1.77 N/mm（阔叶浆），转数取 0、4000、8000、12,000、16,000 r 共 5 个水平；对应打浆度约 16、20、40、63、79 °SR（针叶浆）与 0、26、40、57、70 °SR（阔叶浆）[1]。

**主要结果**
- 形态与润胀：两种浆的宏观纤丝化指数与纤维长度均呈下降趋势，针叶浆细小纤维含量呈上升趋势；针叶浆这两项变化显著，而阔叶浆的这两项变化相对于针叶浆不显著；作者将其归因于阔叶浆所用打浆压力较低，这是作者的解释，并非已验证的因果关系[5]。打浆度与 WRV 随转数显著上升，作者认为这是纤丝化产生新表面与孔隙造成的[5]。
- 强度：干纸页抗张强度提高，湿纸幅强度上升；针叶浆在湿纸幅强度上的增幅更明显，作者认为纤维长度起关键作用[5]。零距抗张结果表明 PFI 打浆未降低纤维强度[5]；这并不排除纤维强度在其他方面或更高打浆程度下发生变化。
- 结晶区：晶型未变；CI-XI 与 CI-XA 分别下降 4.66%/15.47%（针叶）与 2.65%/19.4%（阔叶）；两种指数显著相关（针叶 r = 0.919、阔叶 r = 0.925，p < 0.05）；微晶尺寸变化很小（约 3.0–4.8 nm）[9]。
- 氢键：O(6)H···O(3′) 含量总体下降 16.54%（针叶）与 5.91%（阔叶）；O(3)H···O(5) 上升 22.78% 与 8.8%；O(2)H···O(6) 总体下降，仅在 0→4000 r 阶段上升[8]。上述变化并非单调：O(6)H···O(3′) 先降后升再降，O(2)H···O(6) 先升后降再升，O(3)H···O(5) 先升、小幅降、再升[8]。
- 作者结论：纤丝化与纤维性能变化同超分子结构（微晶尺寸、结晶度、各类氢键含量）变化相关；CI-XI 与 O(6)H···O(3′) 含量显著正相关，因此作者提出打浆时可由 CI-XI 推测该氢键趋势（这是相关关系上的推测，非因果证明）；总体结晶度、微晶尺寸与各类氢键含量变化不大，作者据此认为 PFI 打浆是以纤丝化为主、对超分子结构破坏较小的温和机械处理[7]。

**未能确定的事项**
1. 非木材纤维论文的原始数据（纤维指标、纸浆强度指标、回归/相关系数、样本量）均未获得，因此无法核对其处理水平与样本量的对应关系；
2. 因而无法判断两文在“纤维长度、细小纤维含量与抗张强度关系”等命题上是否一致，也无法核对是否存在相反的报道；
3. 本文数值均为 PFI 论文自身的相对变化，且只涉及针叶材与阔叶材漂白硫酸盐浆，不可外推为非木材纤维的规律，也不能作为两文共同结论。

如能提供该非木材纤维文献的 PDF、DOI 或库中文档名，可再做逐表逐图对比并给出真正的共同结论。

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
Mechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired physical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic fibers. Therein, Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining is the most common laboratory refiner in order to improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main efects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [1]. These efects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
 It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during refining [7,8].

There are some diferent conclusions regarding to the efects of PFI refining on crystallinity of cellulose, not like that of ball milling, which efectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment progresses. Although some researchers considered that the crystallinity decreased during PFI refining for corn stover [9] or softwood pulp [10], some researchers reported that the crystallinity increased first and then decreased with the degree of refining for hardwood bleached kraft pulp fibers [11] or for unbleached eucalyptus fibers [12]. Moreover, Zhao et al. [7] reported that the crystallinity initially fluctuated upward and then downward, followed by a repeating fluctuation with PFI refining for tobacco stem mechanical pulp. None of the previous studies identified a clear trend, but the results were that the crystallinity varied during PFI refinement. Based on the large proportion of H-bonds in crystalline region of cellulose, it can be assumed that the H-bonding network might change during PFI refining.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
Fourier transformation infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), which is sensitive to molecular structure, can be as an indirect measurement for studying H-bonding network. FT-IR deconvolution of hydroxyl groups band was adopted in order to study the changes of the energy of H-bonds and the H-bonding distance during delignification [13] or the deconstruction of cellulose [14]. Moreover, it was used to study the diferences of the content of H-bonds not only between dislocation region and normal region [15], but also among plant species [16,17]. Regarding the changes of H-bonding network during PFI refining, Yuan et al. [18] reported that the content of H-bonds and crystallinity index (CI) of eucalyptus fibers changed with the increment of beating time. Subsequently, Zhao et al. [8] found that the H-bonding energy for O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) inter-molecular H-bonds decreased by 12.9% and evolutions of the content of certain H-bonds difered at various refining stages.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction
[原文]
There is still a lack of literature on the efects of PFI refinement on the H-bonding network. Particularly, the relationship between the content of H-bonds and crystallinity is still worthy of further study, which will deepen the understanding of the molecular aggregation and distribution of H-bonds, providing a molecular-scale explanation for the variations in accessibility, swelling, flexibility, and fibrillation of cellulosic fibers during PFI refinement. Therefore, this work explored the efects of PFI refinement on the CI, crystallite size, energy of H-bonds, H-bonding distance, and content of H-bonds for softwood pulp fibers and hardwood pulp fibers. Attempts were made in order to establish the correlations between the CI and content of various H-bonds.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 2. Methods > 2.1. PFI Refining
[原文]
Commercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp fibers were obtained from Zhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China). Two pulp were treated with a PFI refiner (Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency of 10%, the gap between the opposite refining plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were 3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, respectively. The drainability was characterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp fibers were separately refined in a PFI refiner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an increasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79<sup>◦</sup> SR, were obtained for softwood fibers and 0, 26, 40, 57, and 70<sup>◦</sup> SR were obtained for hardwood fibers.

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 4. Conclusions
[原文]
The results indicated that the fibrillation and properties of fibers are related to the variation of the supramolecular structure during PFI refining. It is noticeable that there was a significantly positive correlation between the CI-XI and content of O(6)H· · · O(3)’ H-bonds during PFI refining for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers. Thus, the trend of the content of O(6)H· · · O(3)’ H-bonds might be generally speculated based on CI-XI while refining. Besides, the crystallite size, crystallinity, and content of various H-bonds did not change much in general. It is assumed that PFI refining is an excellent mechanical treatment of fibrillation with relatively little destruction on the supramolecular structure.

 On the whole, the amount of the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers decreased by 16.54% and 5.91% altogether, respectively. The decrease might be due to the cleavage among cellulose molecular chains under the mechanical action of PFI refining, which was closely related to internal and external fibrillation (as seen in Section 3.1). On the other hand, the increase illustrates that there was not only the breakage, but also the formation of O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds. Both the fewer inter-molecular H-bonds and the lower CI (as Section 3.2 shows) will further improve the flexibility of cellulosic fibers, due to the higher mobility of molecular chains, the accessibility, and the WRV of fibers (as seen in Section 3.1).

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds
[原文]
As to the O(3)H· · · O(5) intra-molecular H-bonds of softwood fiber, the content had a growth of 10.09% from 28.44% to 31.31% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r, and then had a slight decrease of 1.44% from 4000 r to 8000 r, followed by an increase of 13.16% until the end of refining. Overall, the trend was similar to that of hardwood fibers, which first increased and then had a decrease, followed by a growth. During the whole refining, the amount of $\mathrm { O } ( 3 ) \mathrm { H } \cdots \mathrm { O } ( 5 )$ H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers showed an upward tendency and increased by 22.78% and 8.8%, respectively. The increase might be because the stable O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds might have not only less breakage under the action of water as destructor to the crystallites [30], but also creation in the amorphous region upon drying. Because hydrogen bond–covalent bond synergies play an important role in the cellulose stifness axial modulus, more O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds will enhance the cellulose stifness [33,34].

In the case of the O(2)H· · · O(6) intra-molecular H-bonds for softwood fiber, the trend of content can be described as two phases. For the content of the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds of hardwood fiber, it increased firstly and then had a decrease that was also followed by an increase. For both fibers, the content of O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds decreased, except for the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r. It might be due to the fact that the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds, which are much more accessible to water, are less stable than O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds.

claims.text: 我检索了两次（已达到本题允许的检索上限），但两次检索都只返回了 PFI 论文（Li 2020，doc_0fcf2a50cfa02d21）；**因此无法从本次可用文献库中检索到《Non-Wood Fibers: Relationships of Fiber Properties with Pulp Properties》，也拿不到它的实验数据**（比如各类非木材原料的纤维长度、宽厚比、细胞壁厚度等指标，以及这些指标与纸浆抗张、耐破、撕裂指数之间的表格、相关性系数或样本量）。因此**无法比较这两篇论文的全部实验数据，也无法给出共同结论**；如果强行给出，就只能是猜测。
下面只陈述有证据支持的 PFI 论文内容；这些内容单独不构成“共同结论”。

**实验条件（仅针叶材与阔叶材漂白硫酸盐浆）**
- PFI 磨打浆：浆浓 10%，盘间隙 0.2 mm，比压 3.33 N/mm（针叶浆）与 1.77 N/mm（阔叶浆），转数取 0、4000、8000、12,000、16,000 r 共 5 个水平；对应打浆度约 16、20、40、63、79 °SR（针叶浆）与 0、26、40、57、70 °SR（阔叶浆）[1]。

**主要结果**
- 形态与润胀：两种浆的宏观纤丝化指数与纤维长度均呈下降趋势，针叶浆细小纤维含量呈上升趋势；针叶浆这两项变化显著，而阔叶浆的这两项变化相对于针叶浆不显著；作者将其归因于阔叶浆所用打浆压力较低，这是作者的解释，并非已验证的因果关系[5]。打浆度与 WRV 随转数显著上升，作者认为这是纤丝化产生新表面与孔隙造成的[5]。
- 强度：干纸页抗张强度提高，湿纸幅强度上升；针叶浆在湿纸幅强度上的增幅更明显，作者认为纤维长度起关键作用[5]。零距抗张结果表明 PFI 打浆未降低纤维强度[5]；这并不排除纤维强度在其他方面或更高打浆程度下发生变化。
- 结晶区：晶型未变；CI-XI 与 CI-XA 分别下降 4.66%/15.47%（针叶）与 2.65%/19.4%（阔叶）；两种指数显著相关（针叶 r = 0.919、阔叶 r = 0.925，p < 0.05）；微晶尺寸变化很小（约 3.0–4.8 nm）[9]。
- 氢键：O(6)H···O(3′) 含量总体下降 16.54%（针叶）与 5.91%（阔叶）；O(3)H···O(5) 上升 22.78% 与 8.8%；O(2)H···O(6) 总体下降，仅在 0→4000 r 阶段上升[8]。上述变化并非单调：O(6)H···O(3′) 先降后升再降，O(2)H···O(6) 先升后降再升，O(3)H···O(5) 先升、小幅降、再升[8]。
- 作者结论：纤丝化与纤维性能变化同超分子结构（微晶尺寸、结晶度、各类氢键含量）变化相关；CI-XI 与 O(6)H···O(3′) 含量显著正相关，因此作者提出打浆时可由 CI-XI 推测该氢键趋势（这是相关关系上的推测，非因果证明）；总体结晶度、微晶尺寸与各类氢键含量变化不大，作者据此认为 PFI 打浆是以纤丝化为主、对超分子结构破坏较小的温和机械处理[7]。

**未能确定的事项**
1. 非木材纤维论文的原始数据（纤维指标、纸浆强度指标、回归/相关系数、样本量）均未获得，因此无法核对其处理水平与样本量的对应关系；
2. 因而无法判断两文在“纤维长度、细小纤维含量与抗张强度关系”等命题上是否一致，也无法核对是否存在相反的报道；

candidate.answer:
按该研究条件（PFI，浆浓 10%、磨盘间隙 0.2 mm；针叶木浆和阔叶木浆每刀长受力分别为 3.33 和 1.77 N/mm）[1] ：

- **12000 转时：针叶木浆为 63 °SR，阔叶木浆为 57 °SR** [1]。
- 对应打浆序列：针叶木浆经 0、4000、8000、12000、16000 转，依次为 **16、20、40、63、79 °SR**；阔叶木浆经相同转数，依次为 **0、26、40、57、70 °SR** [1]。

所以：

- 如果目标浆正是该研究中的**针叶木浆**，那么打到 12000 转确实得到约 63 °SR [1]。
- 不能把“12000 转”当作通用的 63 °SR 条件：同转数下**阔叶木浆仅 57 °SR**，要达到 63 °SR 需高于 12000 转；但文献只给出 12000 转时对应 57 °SR、16000 转时对应 70 °SR，未给出确切所需转数，需在 12000–16000 转之间试打确定 [1]。
- 浆种及批次、初始打浆度、PFI 载荷、磨盘间隙、浆浓和磨片状态都会改变打浆曲线，实际应以**实测 °SR**为准，12000 转只宜作参考起点。文献未报告打浆度数据的重复性或误差范围 [1]。

[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 2. Methods > 2.1. PFI Refining
[原文]
Commercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp fibers were obtained from Zhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China). Two pulp were treated with a PFI refiner (Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency of 10%, the gap between the opposite refining plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were 3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, respectively. The drainability was characterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp fibers were separately refined in a PFI refiner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an increasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79<sup>◦</sup> SR, were obtained for softwood fibers and 0, 26, 40, 57, and 70<sup>◦</sup> SR were obtained for hardwood fibers.

- 如果目标浆正是该研究中的**针叶木浆**，那么打到 12000 转确实得到约 63 °SR [1]。
- 不能把“12000 转”当作通用的 63 °SR 条件：同转数下**阔叶木浆仅 57 °SR**，要达到 63 °SR 需高于 12000 转；但文献只给出 12000 转时对应 57 °SR、16000 转时对应 70 °SR，未给出确切所需转数，需在 12000–16000 转之间试打确定 [1]。
- 浆种及批次、初始打浆度、PFI 载荷、磨盘间隙、浆浓和磨片状态都会改变打浆曲线，实际应以**实测 °SR**为准，12000 转只宜作参考起点。文献未报告打浆度数据的重复性或误差范围 [1]。

fixed_draft:
按该研究的 PFI 条件（浆浓 10%、磨盘间隙 0.2 mm；针叶木浆和阔叶木浆的比压分别为 3.33 N/mm 和 1.77 N/mm），**12000 转时：针叶木浆为 63 °SR，阔叶木浆为 57 °SR** [1]。

对应的打浆序列是：

- 针叶木浆：0、4000、8000、12000、16000 转 → **16、20、40、63、79 °SR**
- 阔叶木浆：同样转数 → **0、26、40、57、70 °SR** [1]

因此：

- 如果目标浆就是该研究中的**针叶木浆**，那么打到 12000 转确实对应约 63 °SR。
- 但不能把“12000 转”当成通用的 63 °SR 配方。相同转数下，**阔叶木浆只有 57 °SR**；若要达到 63 °SR，需要超过 12000 转，但文献没有给出确切转数，只显示 16000 转为 70 °SR，因此实际需在 12000–16000 转之间试打确定 [1]。
- 不同浆种和批次、初始打浆度、PFI 载荷、盘间隙、浆浓及磨片状态都会改变打浆曲线，生产上应以**实测 °SR**为准，12000 转只能作为参考起点。文献未报告该打浆度数据的重复性误差。

reference.question: PFI打到12000转的时候，针叶木浆和阔叶木浆的打浆度各是多少？那我们以后想要63 °SR左右的浆，是不是直接打12000转就行了？
reference.reference_answer: 方法部分给出的12000转对应针叶木63 °SR、阔叶木57 °SR。相同转数在本文不同浆种/条件下得到的打浆度不同，不能据此建立适用于所有纸浆的唯一换算。两类浆的作用力也不同，不能把差异全部归因于浆种。
